Innovative 3D-printed porous piezoelectric poly(vinylidene fluoride) cages with accelerated spinal fusion.

High AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Read now animal Exp. validation
Hao Zhang, Guoqing Gao, Lihan Wang, Chunlu Li, Chang Xu et al. Materials today. Bio 2025-12-01 10.1016/j.mtbio.2025.102333
单位: Department of Orthopedics, Central Hospital of Dalian University of Technology, Dalian, China.
通讯: Lin Sang @ Department of Orthopedics, Central Hospital of Dalian University of Technology, Dalian, China.; School of Materials Scie [推断]
相关性: 该论文直接涉及3D打印多孔结构、力学性能匹配（压缩性能类似骨小梁）以及体内骨整合验证，与AM生物医学方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not cover LPBF fabrication (uses FDM), fatigue testing, or stress shielding quantification for hip implants.
动机· 脊柱融合笼骨整合差导致临床失败，需开发兼具压电效应和力学匹配的植入体。
方法· 3D打印PVDF/PLA/BTO复合多孔笼，调控填充密度优化压电和力学性能。
结果· 低填充密度压电更强，压缩性能类似骨小梁，体内骨体积达76.8%。
验证· 体外细胞实验和绵羊体内植入三个月验证骨整合效果。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Poor osseointegration of spinal cages leads to clinical failure, motivating the development of piezoelectric cages with biomimetic mechanics.
Method· Porous PVDF/PLA/BTO cages with triangular lattice were fabricated via FDM 3D printing, with infill density varied to tune piezoelectric and compressive properties.
Result· Lower infill density enhanced piezoelectric output; all samples matched trabecular bone stiffness; in vivo bone volume reached 76.8% after three months.
Validation· In vitro cell assays and in vivo sheep model with micro-CT and histology confirmed osseointegration.

A Macro-Micro FE and Machine Learning Based Design of Diamond Lattice Tibial Implant to Improve Biomechanical and Osseointegration Performance.

High AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Read now simulation_case
Minku, Rajesh Ghosh International journal for numerical methods in biomedical engineering 2025-12-01 10.1002/cnm.70133
单位: Biomechanics Research Laboratory, School of Mechanical & Materials Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Mandi, Kamand, Mandi, Himachal Pradesh, India.
通讯: Rajesh Ghosh @ Biomechanics Research Laboratory, School of Mechanical & Materials Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Mandi, Ka [推断]
相关性: 该论文直接针对多孔晶格结构植入物的应力屏蔽和骨整合性能，使用有限元与机器学习结合的方法，与用户研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper lacks experimental validation (no LPBF fabrication or mechanical testing) and does not report surface roughness or as-built morphology.
动机· 优化踝关节置换中多孔胫骨植入物的孔隙率以减少应力屏蔽并促进骨整合。
方法· 结合宏微观有限元与机器学习预测骨长入，评估四种孔隙率（50%-80%）的金刚石晶格结构。
结果· 70%孔隙率植入物在骨形成和载荷传递方面优于传统实心植入物，80%孔隙率骨长入最差。
验证· 仅通过有限元模拟和机器学习预测，无实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To optimize the porosity of porous tibial implants for total ankle replacement to reduce stress shielding and enhance osseointegration.
Method· A combined macro-micro finite element and machine learning approach was used to predict site-specific bone ingrowth for four diamond lattice structures with porosities from 50% to 80%.
Result· The 70% porosity implant showed superior bone formation and load transfer compared to solid implants, while 80% porosity yielded the lowest bone ingrowth.
Validation· Validation was limited to simulation and ML prediction without experimental fabrication or mechanical testing.

High FEA & Surrogate Modelling arxiv Transferable Save for project simulation_case Patient-specific
Bei Zhou, Cesare Corrado, Shuang Qian, Maximilian Balmus, Angela W. C. Lee et al. arXiv preprint 2025-12-01 link
相关性: 该论文提出了一种几何无关的算子学习框架，可迁移至植入物生物力学中的代理建模，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
边界: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant-specific biomechanics (e.g., stress shielding, micromotion).
动机· 解决异构几何上算子学习对网格和几何的依赖问题
方法· 在流形上定义内在坐标空间，解耦算子学习与几何变化
结果· 在心房和心室几何上优于现有算子，并推广至心脏生物力学
验证· 基于GPU加速模拟生成的高保真数据集进行数值验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To overcome the dependence of neural operator learning on structured discretizations and geometric variability in heterogeneous geometries.
Method· Reformulates operator learning in an intrinsic coordinate space on the underlying manifold, decoupling it from mesh and geometry.
Result· Outperforms established neural operators on atrial and ventricular geometries and generalizes to cardiac biomechanics.
Validation· Validated on large-scale GPU-accelerated simulation datasets of patient-specific cardiac electrophysiology and biomechanics.

Sofia Baroni, Sara Oliviero, Marco Viceconti, Cristina Curreli Journal of biomechanical engineering 2025-12-01 10.1115/1.4070009
单位: Department of Industrial Engineering, Alma Mater Studiorum-University of Bologna, Bologna 40126, Italy.
通讯: Cristina Curreli @ Medical Technology Lab, IRCCS Istituto Ortopedico Rizzoli, Bologna 40136, Italy. [推断]
相关性: 该论文直接针对无骨水泥髋关节假体的无菌性松动预测，建立了结合骨整合和纤维化的计算框架，与用户的研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not explicitly report stress/strain/SED in Gruen zones or micromotion values with contact/friction modeling, and it does not compare intact vs implanted femur.
动机· 开发预测无骨水泥髋关节假体无菌性松动的计算框架
方法· 将有限元模型与有限状态机耦合，模拟骨整合和纤维化过程
结果· 模型能预测羟基磷灰石涂层改善骨整合，在某些情况下防止无菌性松动
验证· 与已有文献的骨整合模式进行定性比较
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop a computational framework for predicting aseptic loosening in cementless hip stems by integrating biomechanical factors and biological response to osteoinductive coatings.
Method· A finite element model of a femur implanted with a cementless stem was coupled with a Finite State Machine to simulate osseointegration and tissue fibrotization, with the osteoinductive coating modeled by adjusting maximum gap and bone growth rate.
Result· The framework predicted improved osseointegration with hydroxyapatite coating at two years, and in two cases the coating prevented aseptic loosening that occurred for uncoated stems.
Validation· Osseointegration patterns were compared qualitatively with previously reported data.

单位: Department of Orthopaedics and Trauma, Peking University People's Hospital, Beijing, China.; National Centre for Trauma Medicine, Peking University People's Hospital, Beijing, China.; Key Laboratory o
通讯: Dianying Zhang @ Department of Orthopaedics and Trauma, Peking University People's Hospital, Beijing, China.; National Centre for Trauma [推断]
相关性: 该论文直接评估了新型仿生髋关节假体的初始稳定性和应力遮挡，与用户研究方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not report stress/strain distribution in Gruen zones, does not use patient-specific models, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur.
动机· 设计新型仿生髋关节假体以减少应力遮挡并保证初始稳定性。
方法· 将BHA假体植入Sawbones股骨，进行动态疲劳和静态失效测试。
结果· 假体下沉位移小于1.5mm，在10万次循环后达到二次固定，失效载荷约6.4倍体重。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To design a novel bionic hip prosthesis that reduces stress shielding by mimicking physiological load transfer while ensuring sufficient initial stability.
Method· BHA prostheses were implanted into Sawbones composite femurs and subjected to dynamic fatigue testing (1,000,000 cycles) and static failure testing.
Result· Irreversible subsidence was 0.3683 mm, below the 1.5 mm threshold; secondary fixation was achieved at 100,000 cycles; average failure load was 4485 N.
Validation· Mechanical testing on Sawbones composite femurs under dynamic and static loading conditions.

Motivation· To overcome the insufficient mechanical properties and slow degradation of Zn-based biodegradable implants for bone repair.
Method· Laser powder bed fusion was used to fabricate Zn-2Al-Mg eutectic alloys with programmable lamellar structures via Mg doping and rapid solidification.

Validation· The method is validated on five benchmark PDEs, demonstrating accuracy and inference speedup.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The pathological microenvironment in diabetes, characterized by oxidative stress and immune dysregulation, impairs osseointegration, necessitating effective surface modification strategies for implants.
Method· A multilayered structure composed of 18β-glycyrrhetinic acid-modified chitosan and gelatin embedded with Mn3O4 nanozymes was fabricated on titanium implants via layer-by-layer self-assembly.
Result· The coating synergistically alleviated oxidative stress, reprogrammed macrophages to anti-inflammatory M2 phenotype, and enhanced osteoblast differentiation, achieving satisfactory osseointegration in a T2DM rat bone defect model.
Validation· In vitro assays with macrophages under simulated diabetic conditions and in vivo implantation in a type 2 diabetic rat bone defect model.

Motivation· To evaluate the compressive behavior of SLM-fabricated AlSi10Mg square and rectangular hollow sections and assess the applicability of existing design standards.
Method· Experimental compression tests were conducted on SHS/RHS specimens with varying slenderness and build orientations, complemented by material characterization and geometric imperfection measurements.
Result· The EN 1999-1-1 slenderness limit for Class 3 internal elements was overly conservative, and the effective thickness equation underestimated the compressive response; the continuous strength method provided more accurate ultimate capacity predictions.

Motivation· To investigate the effect of repeated recycling of Ti6Al4V powders on powder characteristics and the quality of SLM-fabricated parts.

Motivation· To investigate how finish-line quality and axial surface location affect the marginal adaptation of SLM-fabricated dental copings.
Method· Margin width, curvature, and finish-line grade were measured on four axial surfaces of prepared typodont teeth, and marginal gaps of SLM copings were analyzed using statistical tests.

Motivation· Exact posterior inference in Bayesian neural networks is computationally intractable, and existing approximations struggle with scalability and accuracy in modern deep networks.
Method· The authors propose a simple sampling variation that leverages the low-dimensional structure of loss minima, and introduce a model that learns a deformation of the parameter space for rapid posterior sampling.
Result· The approach achieves competitive posterior approximations with improved scalability compared to recent refinement techniques.
Validation· Empirical validation is performed on standard benchmark datasets, demonstrating scalability and approximation quality.

Motivation· To evaluate the in vivo breakage risk of small cementless femoral stems in patients exceeding the weight limit from biomechanical tests.

Motivation· To determine whether computer navigation assistance improves the accuracy of cam resection and clinical outcomes in hip arthroscopic osteochondroplasty compared to freehand technique.
Method· A retrospective comparative study of 55 hips (25 navigation-assisted, 30 freehand) using preoperative and postoperative CT to assess range of motion and impingement points.

Motivation· To compare clinical outcomes of labral repair versus reconstruction during primary hip arthroscopy.

Zhimian Zhang, Xiaobing Xiang, Jianfa Chen, Jie Li, Yuanyuan Wang Arthroscopy techniques 2025-12-01 10.1016/j.eats.2025.103952
单位: Department of Sports Medicine, The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou University of Chinese Medicine, Guangzhou, China.
通讯: Yuanyuan Wang @ Department of Sports Medicine, The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou University of Chinese Medicine, Guangzhou, Chi [推断]
相关性: 该论文涉及肩关节骨缺损修复，与髋关节假体应力遮挡和微动分析无关。
边界: Does not address hip implant, femoral stem, stress shielding, micromotion, or contact mechanics; focuses on shoulder glenoid bone grafting.
动机· 肩关节不稳伴盂骨缺损需要可靠的骨移植固定方法。
方法· 采用锚钉非刚性固定的关节镜下自体髂骨植骨术。
结果· 简化手术步骤并避免金属硬件相关并发症。
验证· 无实验或临床验证，仅为技术描述。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Glenoid bone loss in recurrent shoulder dislocation requires effective bone grafting fixation methods.
Method· An all-arthroscopic Eden-Hybinette technique using suture anchor fixation is described.
Result· The technique simplifies the procedure and avoids complications from permanent metallic hardware.
Validation· No experimental validation; purely a technical note.
